env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
mkdir $WORK/bin

mkdir negmod/a
cp pos/go.mod negmod/go.mod
cp pos/a/a.lgo negmod/a/a.lgo

cd negmod
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/neg$GOEXE ./field
stderr 'correctness::nil_deref_unproven'
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/neg$GOEXE ./prop
stderr 'correctness::nil_deref_unproven'
! logos build -o $WORK/bin/neg$GOEXE ./result
stderr 'correctness::nil_deref_unproven'
cd ..

cd pos
logos run .
stdout '^ok field-absent$'
stdout '^ok field-pointer$'
stdout '^ok field-int$'
stdout '^ok assert-field$'
stdout '^ok assert-property$'
stdout '^ok prop-absent$'
stdout '^ok prop-pointer$'
stdout '^ok func-result$'
stdout '^ok func-absent$'
stdout '^ok func-param$'
stdout '^ok func-nil$'
! stdout 'FAIL'
cp stdout ../native.txt
logos eject -o out
exists out/main.go
cd out
# SPEC 0.3: ejected output builds with upstream go1.27.2 from $UPROOT1272.
exists $UPROOT1272/bin/go
exec env -u GOROOT $UPROOT1272/bin/go run .
cmp stdout ../../native.txt
cd ../..

-- pos/go.mod --
module example.com/gen

go 1.27

-- pos/a/a.lgo --
package a

type Item struct{ N int }

type Counter interface {
	Cnt int?
}

type Box[T any] struct {
	Opt *Item?
	Cnt int?
	V   T
}

type Held[T any] struct : Counter {
	Cnt int?
	V   T
}

type Prop[T any] interface {
	Opt *Item?
	V   T
}

type Impl[T any] struct : Prop[T] {
	Opt *Item?
	V   T
}

func Find[T any](v T, ok bool) *Item? {
	if ok {
		return &Item{N: 5}
	}
	return nil
}

func Keep[T any](v T, c int?) int? {
	return c
}

-- pos/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/gen/a"
)

func report(name string, ok bool) {
	if ok {
		fmt.Println("ok", name)
		return
	}
	fmt.Println("FAIL", name)
}

func main() {
	b := &a.Box[int]{V: 1}
	report("field-absent", b.Opt == nil && b.Cnt == nil)
	b.Opt = &a.Item{N: 4}
	b.Cnt = 3
	report("field-pointer", (b.Opt?.N ?? -1) == 4)
	report("field-int", (b.Cnt ?? 0) == 3)

	h := &a.Held[int]{V: 1}
	h.Cnt = 3
	report("assert-field", (h.Cnt ?? 0) == 3)
	var c a.Counter = h
	c.Cnt = 5
	report("assert-property", (c.Cnt ?? 0) == 5 && (h.Cnt ?? 0) == 5)

	var p a.Prop[int] = &a.Impl[int]{V: 2}
	report("prop-absent", p.Opt == nil)
	item := &a.Item{N: 6}
	p.Opt = item
	report("prop-pointer", (p.Opt?.N ?? -1) == 6)

	report("func-result", (a.Find(1, true)?.N ?? -1) == 5)
	report("func-absent", a.Find(1, false) == nil)
	report("func-param", (a.Keep[int](1, 7) ?? -1) == 7)
	report("func-nil", a.Keep[int](1, nil) == nil)
}

-- negmod/field/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/gen/a"
)

func main() {
	g := &a.Box[int]{}
	fmt.Println(g.Opt.N)
}

-- negmod/prop/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/gen/a"
)

func main() {
	var p a.Prop[int] = &a.Impl[int]{}
	fmt.Println(p.Opt.N)
}

-- negmod/result/main.lgo --
package main

import (
	"fmt"

	"example.com/gen/a"
)

func main() {
	fmt.Println(a.Find(1, true).N)
}
